notes.title: Circles combines hide and seek with a steady hand
notes.notes: Circles [official site] caught my eye because I tend to be attracted by that particular clean, geometric aesthetic and I went in expecting something like a logic puzzle because that’s a genre which seems to marry up with the art style – clean lines, logical solutions. But having played the free online demo Circles is actually more like one of those wire loop games from fairs where you have a long, wiggle line of wire and must pass a loop along it without the two touching and setting off a buzzer. … [visit site to read more]
